rubric.note: Overall proportions match the sheet-1 front view (head/height 0.13 on both; shoulder/height 0.33 concept vs 0.36 model; hip/height 0.21 vs 0.20; hands end at 0.67 vs 0.64). The shape language does not: the concept is curved, overlapping armour, the model is primitives (box torso tapering to a trapezoid, hemisphere-on-ball pauldrons, square box thighs, straight box shanks with no calf swell or knee cop). Waist/shoulder is 0.40 against the concept's pinched 0.32, so the hourglass is lost. Hands are stick tips about 0.014 of height wide against about 0.05 for the fingered gauntlets; feet are short blocks, not long sabatons. The side view is a flat column with none of the concept's chest depth. It reads as a wooden mannequin, not an armoured automaton.

Credits: the hexagonal chest core in a pale bezel (lit amber in the glow build, p95 (249,218,94)), the back gear medallion, the capsule head with two horizontal amber eye slits (art-bible default), and the ringed abdomen standing in for the ribbed midriff. Misses: no jewel inlays (0 emerald/sapphire/ruby pixels on every model render, against 1230 and 1309 jewel pixels on the concept's side and back views); no lit amber channel down the abdomen; the head lacks the concept's mask silhouette (brow, cheek planes, jaw, exposed gunmetal neck pistons).

No plate seams, panel lines, bevels or overlapping plate edges, the concept's main surface language. The tiling brass reads as wood on flat box faces (streaky grain, blotchy cream patches on the crotch plate, chest and face plate). Lit faces turn flat cream: model-low-front body p90 (202,173,143) against the concept's warm gold p90 (192,153,101); shin faces flash near-white in the attack and hit stills. Gunmetal ball joints are correctly dark but bare spheres, not ribbed cylinder knees and elbows. Pauldrons are the only surfaces that read as polished metal.

Warm-metal median: concept front body (91,66,49), hue 24, L 0.27, S 0.30; engine glow build upper body (94,70,36), hue 35, L 0.25, S 0.45. Value matches but the hue is 11 degrees yellower and more saturated (olive-ochre rather than warm bronze). In-room legs (103,80,56) are close to the concept. The core peaks warm yellow p95 (249,218,94) where the concept core is white-hot p95 (254,249,166). Eyes match well (concept p90 (249,209,108), model (235,206,129)). No jewel accent colour anywhere.

At 2-4 m the tall thin figure separates clearly from the low Spring Hound and the amber eyes and core give a focal point. Against that, the box-and-ball construction reads as a mannequin or toy, pale faces flash in motion, and the thin limbs and tiny hands read as wire against the bookcases. In every xr-emu-15 frame the enemy HUD panel covers the torso and core; counted as a panel-placement issue, not a model fault.

topFixes: Remodel the armour as curved, overlapping plates instead of primitives: a cuirass with a pinched gunmetal waist (waist/shoulder near 0.32, now 0.40), layered curved pauldrons, tapered cuisses wrapping the hips, greaves that swell at the calf with knee cops over ribbed cylinder knees, fingered gauntlets about 0.05 of height wide, long pointed sabatons, and chest depth in the side view.

Add the missing signature parts: faceted jewel inlays on the outer thighs and upper arms as on sheet-1, the lit amber channel down the abdomen, and a masked head with brow, cheek planes and jaw over exposed neck pistons.

Fix the brass and the core: replace the wood-grain-looking tileable on flat faces, stop lit faces going cream (p90 (202,173,143) vs concept (192,153,101)), pull hue from 35 toward 24, and push the core centre toward white-hot (about (255,250,204)). Separately, move the enemy HUD panel off the Sentry's torso in the seated view.
independentScore.method: Independent reviewer (did not build the model) on 2026-11-16. Shape: assets-source/enemies/cog-sentry/staging/renders/model-low-{front,side,back}.png, model-high-three-quarter.png and cog-sentry.review-sheet.jpg, generated from public/assets/enemies/cog-sentry/cog-sentry.glb whose sha256 matches provenance. Concept: assets-source/concepts/sentry-sheet-1.png (approved), sentry-sheet-2.png secondary. Colour and glow: docs/verification/p6-glow-cog-sentry.jpg and xr-emu-15-enemy-turn-00..10.jpg; p4-sentry-*.jpg (pre-glow) for shape and pose only. Pillow and NumPy medians, HLS, percentile means over a warm-metal mask; HSV masks for jewels and glow. Strictness calibrated against orrery-warden (82) and bellows-golem (73); author self-score ignored.
